usage: dotnet meta <command> [options]
  commands:
    gen <metadataDir> --out <dir> --namespace <ns> [--emit-abstract-shapes]
        [--generators <a,b,c>] [--template-root <dir>]
                                                     generate EF Core code from metadata
    gen --list                                       list available generators (stable names) and exit
    verify <metadataDir> [--templates <root>] [--codegen --out <dir> [--namespace <ns>]] [--db]
                                                     drift gates (ADR-0021 D2 subverbs):
                                                       --templates  template/prompt drift (default)
                                                       --codegen    regen-to-temp vs committed --out
                                                       --namespace  codegen regen namespace; inferred
                                                                    from the committed --out when omitted
                                                       --db         NOT supported in C# (migrate engine)
    docs <metadataDir> --out <dir> [--namespace <ns>] [--project <name>] [--model-base-url <url>]
                                                     emit the generated C# SDK api reference
                                                     (the api/csharp surface: one page per
                                                     entity + template, README, AGENT-API)
    agent-docs [--server <lang>]... [--client <fw>]... [--out <dir>]
                                                     scaffold the slim MetaObjects Claude Code
                                                     agent context (defaults to csharp when a
                                                     *.csproj is present)
